financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Public offering of 1,250,000 units (share plus warrant) at $6.00 per unit via Canaccord Genuity
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The net proceeds from the offering were approximately $6,766,000, after deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses, and excluding the exercise of any warrants.

warrants.quote: The common stock warrants are exercisable immediately and will expire on November 2, 2028, five years from the date of issuance.
As of September 30, 2023 and December 31, 2022, 2,400 of the warrants were outstanding.
